findings.quote: Then I m coming too, Rosa said.
findings.claim: The chapter s closing line restates what Rosa has just said in Also I want to go. I want to see what s there, so the ending lands on a beat the reader has already been given.
findings.fix: Cut the earlier declaration and let the closing line be the only one, or let her stance and the pause carry the end.
